common.tagline: HR and payroll for Bangladesh and beyond

home.title: One HR platform for every kind of organization
home.body: Groups of companies, factories, corporates and NGOs: core HR, attendance, leave and payroll that follow Bangladesh law out of the box.

roleDescriptions.hr_admin: All of HR: people, organisation, leave, attendance, documents, letters, notifications and the audit log. Not logins.
roleDescriptions.hr_officer: Day-to-day HR: people (with identity numbers), leave, attendance, documents, lifecycle, imports and HR approvals. Not the organisation set-up or notification settings.
roleDescriptions.attendance_officer: Attendance only: shifts, rosters, devices, punches and corrections, and reading the employee list (identity numbers hidden).
roleDescriptions.auditor: Reads the employee list (identity numbers hidden) and the audit log. Changes nothing.
roleDescriptions.employee: Self-service: their own profile, leave, attendance, documents and their team's approvals.
roleDescriptions.payroll_officer: Payroll: sees salaries and proposes pay changes, which someone else approves. Reads the employee list.
roleDescriptions.finance_officer: Approves pay changes made by others, sees salaries and the audit log. Changes nothing else.

setup.title: Go-live checklist
setup.intro: What this workspace still needs before people rely on it. Each step is checked against your data, so it is always up to date.

setup.outsideApp: Some go-live steps happen outside the app: a parallel month with your current process, legal review of letters and leave rules, and a tested backup. See docs/ops/go-live.md.

basisHint.gross: HR enters the gross; the lines split it (use GROSS).
basisHint.basic: HR enters the basic; the lines build on it (use BASIC).

structures.formulaHelp: Formulas use component codes, GROSS or BASIC, + − × ÷, and min, max, round, floor, ceil, abs, if. Example: round((GROSS - 2450) / 1.5). For a gross structure, the lines counted in gross must add up to the gross.
